description: Read a NIfTI-1/NIfTI-2 header in MATLAB or GNU Octave with no toolbox: dimensions, voxel size, datatype, units, qform and sform affines, whether they agree, and the voxel-axis orientation code (e.g. LAS). Writes header.json and returns the same record inline. The reference tool for the MATLAB adapter.

image.description: NIfTI volume (.nii or .nii.gz). Only the header is read.

header.description: Header record: dim, pixdim, datatype, units, qform, sform, qformSformAgree, orientation.

block.label: NIfTI header (MATLAB)
block.description: Header fields and affines, read in MATLAB or Octave.

requirements: MATLAB R2019a+ (set MATLAB) or GNU Octave 7+ (set OCTAVE)
neuroflow/launch.description: Generates nf_wrapper.m in the work dir and runs nf_nifti_header(nf.inputs.image, nf.outputDir) headlessly; header.json lands in the output dir and the returned struct in $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_FILE.
